name: io.voiceaiagents/directory
title: voiceaiagents.io
description: Search and compare voice AI agents, with pricing and features checked on each vendor's site.

tools.name: search_agents
tools.description: Find voice AI agents in the voiceaiagents.io directory. All filters are optional and combine with AND. Returns short cards ranked as the directory ranks them; call get_agent for full details.

query.description: Words that must all appear in the agent's name, tagline, summary, category, industries or starting price, e.g. "appointment booking".

category.description: A category slug from list_categories, e.g. customer-support.

industries.description: Industry slugs from list_industries; matches any of them.

deployment.description: Agents that run "both" ways match cloud and self-hosted.

tools.name: get_agent
tools.description: Everything the directory knows about one agent: pricing tiers, features, use cases, fit, languages, compliance, integrations, docs and the vendor pages its facts were checked against.

id.description: The agent's id from search_agents, also the slug in its page URL, e.g. vapi.

tools.name: compare_agents
tools.description: Two to five agents side by side: pricing, deployment, open source, languages, compliance, call types, setup, integrations and industries.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: The directory's categories of voice AI agents, with slugs for search_agents and agent counts.

tools.name: list_industries
tools.description: Industries voice AI agents in the directory are built for, with slugs for search_agents and agent counts.
